---
title: Accepted authors
---

Send this to all accepted authors through OpenReview (Authors (Accepted), Select All, Message Selected). Set the reply-to to the workshop Google Group.

**Subject:** AfricaNLP [YEAR]: videos, posters, visas and registration

```text
Dear {{fullname}},

Congratulations again on your accepted paper at the AfricaNLP workshop at [HOST YEAR].
The workshop takes place on [date]. Please read the instructions below.

Pre-recorded video
Prepare a video of your paper, 10 minutes at most, and upload it to Underline.
We will send the upload link when it opens.

Posters
In-person and remote posters run at the same time, for one hour, right after lunch.
Any format is fine. We recommend A0 or A1.

Every presented paper must upload a video, slides or a poster to Underline by
[date]. Instructions: [link]

Visas
Register for [HOST YEAR] to get an invitation letter. The workshop does not issue
its own letters. See [host visa page].

Registration and sponsorship
We will try to give a registration waiver and travel grant to one author per
accepted paper. If you need one, fill in this form by [date]: [link]

Every presenter must register. Authors of non-archival and shared task papers do
not pay the paper fee.

Best regards,
[Name]
On behalf of the AfricaNLP Organizing Committee

Replies to this email go to [workshop Google Group].
```
